## Landmarks

#### ★★☆ Cooperating sequential processes

Edsger Dijkstra · 1965 · *Technical report EWD123* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Cooperating%20sequential%20processes%22)

- **Why:** Semaphores, mutual exclusion and the dining philosophers: concurrency's founding document.
- **Read:** The first half.

#### ★★☆ The structure of the "THE"-multiprogramming system

Edsger Dijkstra · 1968 · *Communications of the ACM* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20structure%20of%20the%20%22THE%22-multiprogramming%20system%22)

- **Why:** The layered OS design that introduced structured systems thinking.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★☆ Time, clocks, and the ordering of events in a distributed system

Leslie Lamport · 1978 · *Communications of the ACM* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Time%2C%20clocks%2C%20and%20the%20ordering%20of%20events%20in%20a%20distributed%20system%22)

- **Why:** Happens-before: the causal ordering underneath every memory model.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★☆ How to make a multiprocessor computer that correctly executes multiprocess programs

Leslie Lamport · 1979 · *IEEE Transactions on Computers* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22How%20to%20make%20a%20multiprocessor%20computer%20that%20correctly%20executes%20multiprocess%20programs%22)

- **Why:** The definition of sequential consistency, in 2 pages.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★★ Scheduling algorithms for multiprogramming in a hard-real-time environment

Liu & Layland · 1973 · *Journal of the ACM* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Scheduling%20algorithms%20for%20multiprogramming%20in%20a%20hard-real-time%20environment%22)

- **Why:** Rate-monotonic scheduling and the utilization bound. The basis of real-time systems.
- **Read:** The first theorems.

#### ★★★ Priority inheritance protocols: An approach to real-time synchronization

Sha, Rajkumar & Lehoczky · 1990 · *IEEE Transactions on Computers* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Priority%20inheritance%20protocols%3A%20An%20approach%20to%20real-time%20synchronization%22)

- **Why:** The priority inheritance protocol: the fix for the Mars Pathfinder bug.
- **Read:** §1–3.
